//! tr kodlu 3 dil=tr
ph_list.TR_mem_filter { TR_ctx_it > ph_limit }

//! tr kodlu 3 dil=tr
ph_list.TR_mem_map { TR_ctx_it * ph_factor }

//! tr kodlu 3 dil=tr
ph_list.TR_mem_reduce(ph_start, (ph_acc, ph_x) => ph_body)

//! tr kodlu 3 dil=tr
[ph_result TR_kw_for ph_item TR_kw_in ph_range TR_kw_if ph_filter]

//! tr kodlu 3 dil=tr
TR_kw_var ph_X = TR_fn_tensor(ph_xs)
TR_kw_var ph_Y = TR_fn_tensor(ph_ys)
TR_kw_var ph_w = TR_fn_tensor(TR_fn_no_grad(TR_fn_randn([ph_shape], TR_arg_seed: 1) * 0.1), TR_arg_requires_grad: TR_kw_true)
TR_kw_var ph_b = TR_fn_tensor([0.0], TR_arg_requires_grad: TR_kw_true)
TR_kw_var ph_optimizer = TR_fn_AdamW([ph_w, ph_b], TR_arg_lr: ph_rate, TR_arg_weight_decay: 0)
TR_kw_for ph_step TR_kw_in 0..ph_steps {
	ph_optimizer.TR_mem_zero_grad()
	TR_kw_var ph_loss = TR_fn_mean((ph_X @ ph_w + ph_b - ph_Y) ** 2)
	TR_fn_backward(ph_loss)
	ph_optimizer.TR_mem_step()
	TR_kw_if ph_step % 100 == 0 { TR_fn_print("ph_step_label {ph_step}: ph_loss_label = {ph_loss.TR_mem_tolist}") }
}
TR_fn_print(TR_fn_no_grad { TR_kw_return ph_X @ ph_w + ph_b })
